articles.title: M6 Mac mini vs M4 Mac mini: What's New and Should You Upgrade?
articles.description: Apple's new Mac mini with M6 and M5 Pro keeps the same five-by-five-inch design as the M4 generation, but changes almost everything inside. The headline upgrades are faster CPU, graphics, and AI performance, higher memory bandwidth, faster storage, Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and 2.5Gb Ethernet as standard. The harder part is the price. The M6 Mac mini starts at $899 with 16GB of memory and a 256GB SSD. That is $100 more than the revised $799 price Apple charged for the same M4 base configuration immediately before this update, and $300 more than the M4 model's original $599 launch price. M5 Pro starts at $1,699, which is $100 above M4 Pro's final $1,599 Apple price and $300 above its original launch price. So is the new Mac mini worth it, and should M4 owners upgrade? Here is the complete comparison.
